svg.desc: Screens → backend processes → authoritative stores → external delivery. Performance boundaries shown: bounded client storage and retries, rate/body limits at the API, finite DB pool/queue, capped location history, bounded push fan-out, and post-state-change delivery. Provider code/configuration is not proof of active production credentials.
svg.text: EasyFix Data Flow Diagram · Level 1 Platform
Screens → backend processes → authoritative stores → external delivery
Outbox exists; no current queueable business mutation
OTP · dashboard · new order · bulk upload
Route-tier dispatch · OTP / JWT / Basic / token
Lifecycle migration + offer/auth indexes are present in the worktree but not proven installed.
Legacy / parity lane (not an authoritative target path)
Technician_mobile_App_v2 ↔ API_AngularClientDashboard · EasyFix_API · old CRM / Angular dashboard. Use for contract parity and cutover verification only.
Client dashboard, filters/notices/maps/signup and CRM bulk-payout shapes include mismatches; CRM caches also need logout review.

Scope note: Performance boundaries shown: bounded client storage and retries, rate/body limits at the API, finite DB pool/queue, capped location history, bounded push fan-out, and post-state-change delivery. Provider code/configuration is not proof of active production credentials.
